text:
Maya H: Alert from Sales Ops: ~120 EU virtual-summit leads landed UNASSIGNED between 09:15-10:45 CET. SLA misses for VIPs.
Eli V: Is the HubSpot webhook returning owner=null or is the RR service dropping it?
Maya H: HubSpot payloads look good. RR returned assigned:null. Sample: ```{
  "lead_id": "EU-312",
  "assigned": null,
  "rotation_slot": 4
}```
Priya S: Quick scan: rotation logic uses hour-based seeding `(timestamp/3600) % team_size` which will shift during DST/zone differences. If service restarted near midnight CET, pointer can jump.
Jon Q: Ugh that explains it. Business needs fast mitigation. What are short-term options?
Priya S: Fast mitigation: 1) set fallback owner for the summit form to `EMEA SDR Pool` in routing map; 2) change RR to deterministic increment `(last_index + 1) % N` (safe config flip); 3) enable 10% canary.
Maya H: Sales Ops wants fallback mapped immediately. I'll coordinate HubSpot workflow change. @Eli can you prepare canary?
Eli V: On it. Will route 10% to hotfix endpoint and notify #marketing-leads. Also bump claim timeout for summit form 120s -> 300s to reduce SLA thrash during rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-check: branch=hotfix/rr-seed-fix, ci=green, smoke=ok
Priya S: I'll push code change + unit test to remove tz dependence and add regression test. After canary (15m) we can promote. Rollback plan: revert routing-map and claim timeout.
Maya H: Agreed. If unassigned_count > 5 for 15m, rollback to fallback-only and escalate to Sales leads.
Eli V: Canary looks clean (0 null assigned in 12m). Promoting to 100% now.
ops-bot: deploy: success -> hotfix/rr-seed-fix rolled to 100% at 5198765578
Maya H: Thanks team. Please add a short incident note for weekly ops review with root cause = timezone-dependent rotation seeding and remediation steps. :thumbsup:
